units.source_text: ……这天晚上，鹤川回到了自己的房间之后，残暑的闷热使我难以成眠。

en.t: ...That evening, after Tsurukawa had returned to his own room, the oppressive heat of late summer made it hard for me to fall asleep.

units.source_text: 还有一种抗拒自渎习惯的心情，夺走了我的睡眠。

en.t: A feeling of resisting the habit of self-abuse also robbed me of sleep.
